title: heterotheca sessiliflora
intro: Heterotheca sessiliflora, commonly known as the stiff goldenrod, is a flowering plant native to North America, belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Heterotheca sessiliflora are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe and relax the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
